snippet.title: Babo & Luda Adventure Trailer
snippet.description:
Babo & Luda Adventure is a 3D platformer with hack and slash combat, run and gun sections, and plenty of chaos

Play as Babo and Luda, explore colorful worlds, fight enemies, and discover what's waiting for you

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4815990/Babo__Luda_adventure/

Wishlist the game and follow the development to stay updated!
